8066.title: Checkout-provider admission accepts an unavailable provider
8066.rootCauseOneLine: Checkout-path admission accepts an absent project-checkout provider, then provisioning retries registration indefinitely.
8066.proposedFix: Require the checkout provider at unmanaged-path request admission, while preserving retry behavior for already accepted requests.
8066.caveats: Direct server regression reproduced twice; packaged CLI, browser and automation scheduling were not exercised end to end.
